name: Grupo Solverde (Solverde - Sociedade de Investimentos Turisticos da Costa Verde)
note: Portuguese casino and hotel group founded in Espinho in 1972. Its 2025 annual report (Relatorio & Contas 2025, notes 15.1 and 32.1) states that 93.67% of the share capital is held by Violas - Sociedade Gestora de Participacoes Sociais, S.A. (the Manuel Violas family holding, Espinho); the remaining 6.33% are treasury shares. Private Portuguese owners, no state link; the group's casinos operate under concessions from the Estado Portugues and it pays gaming taxes (IEJ/IEJO) to the state.
